data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 560.438m on 1 January 2023. During 2023 there was a net favourable movement on prior years of GBP 36.44m (gross), representing a c.6.5% release of opening gross claims reserves. The release is recorded in the technical provisions movement as "Movement arising from prior years (36,440)" and is consistent with the managing agent's commentary of profit releases on open years and generally benign claims development, despite mention of large losses in prior periods such as Hurricane Ian, US winter storm Elliott and the Ukraine conflict which impacted underwriting performance in earlier years.
raw_causal_phrases: Profit releases on open years of GBP 51.6m (2022: GBP 32.0m) were made during the year.

The 2021 YOA has closed with a profit of GBP 84.4m after all standard personal expenses, equivalent to a profit on stamp capacity of 24.1%. The YOA has benefitted from a low incidence of natural catastrophes, although has been impacted by losses arising from the Ukraine conflict.
Large losses impacting the YOA include the Ukraine conflict, and a series of natural catastrophes - the largest being Hurricane Ian and US winter storm Elliott.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves and prior year movement were taken from the Technical Provisions movement table (notes) where 'At 1 January' and 'Movement arising from prior years' are shown (page 28). The prior year development figure is the GROSS amount from that table. No granular line-of-business breakdown for the prior year movement is provided, so aggregate movement is used. Named events and cause mapping are taken from managing agent commentary (pages 5-6) and represent inferred impacts where explicit per-event gross amounts are not provided.
